text: Visitors have raised concerns about the requirement to purchase tickets online well in advance, with no option to buy tickets at the library, leading some to travel without gaining entry. Parking and traffic flow issues were frequently mentioned, including narrow lanes, limited camper parking, and poor signage for speed humps and walkways. Several reviews noted long lines and inadequate communication about security procedures and ticket availability upon arrival. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, the timed entry system and crowding were points of frustration for some visitors.
